cohort: Pregnant women in their third trimester who received a complete COVID-19 vaccination scheme using BNT162b2 or Ad26.COV2.S vaccines, compared to unvaccinated pregnant women and case-matched non-pregnant women.
finding: The BNT162b2 and Ad26.COV2.S vaccines are safe to administer during the third trimester of pregnancy, with their safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity remaining similar to those of the general population.
